#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
long long INF = 1e18;
long long ans = 0;
vector<int> dpr;
int solve(long long n){
	if (n==0) return 0;
	if (n<dpr.size() && dpr[n]) return dpr[n];
	long long lastdif = INF;
	long long x = 1;
	int i=0;
	while (abs(x-n)<=lastdif){
		lastdif = abs(x-n);
		x=x*10+1;
		i++;
	}
	x/=10;
	if (x>n && x/10) {
		if (n<dpr.size())return dpr[n]=min(i+solve(abs(x-n)),i-1+solve(abs(x/10-n)));
		return min(i+solve(abs(x-n)),i-1+solve(abs(x/10-n)));
	}
	if (n<dpr.size())
	return dpr[n]= i+solve(abs(x-n));
	return i+solve(abs(x-n));
}
int main(){
#ifdef NEKROLM
	freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
	freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
#endif
	ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
	long long n; cin >> n;
	dpr.resize(1e7);
	cout << solve(n);

	return 0;
}
